SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', COALESCE(o.airtable_id, o.nocopk::text), 'fields', json_build_object(
  'name', o.name,
  'ecwid_order_id', o.ecwid_order_id,
  'order_number', o.order_number,
  'order_code', o.order_code,
  'status', o.status,
  'order_date', o.order_date,
  'customer_name', o.customer_name,
  'customer_email', o.customer_email,
  'items_json', o.items_json,
  'ecwid_skus', o.ecwid_skus,
  'payment_status', o.payment_status,
  'payment_method', o.payment_method,
  'subtotal', o.subtotal,
  'tax_total', o.tax_total,
  'order_total', o.order_total,
  'currency', o.currency,
  'clover_reconciliation_status', o.clover_reconciliation_status,
  'clover_payment_id', o.clover_payment_id,
  'clover_payment_amount', o.clover_payment_amount,
  'clover_payment_time', o.clover_payment_time,
  'clover_match_confidence', o.clover_match_confidence,
  'reconciled_at', o.reconciled_at,
  'reconciliation_notes', o.reconciliation_notes,
  'ecwid_event_type', o.ecwid_event_type,
  'ecwid_event_id', o.ecwid_event_id,
  'last_webhook_at', o.last_webhook_at,
  'products', COALESCE(lp.product_record_ids, ARRAY[]::text[]),
  'products_report', COALESCE(lp.product_names, ''),
  'product_ids_report', COALESCE(lp.product_ids, '')
)) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC), '[]'::json) AS records
FROM public.ecommerce_orders o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    array_agg(COALESCE(p.airtable_id, p.nocopk::text) ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_record_ids,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.name_mat, p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_names,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_ids
  FROM public._m2m_products_ecommerce_orders_ecommerce_orders m
  JOIN public.products p ON p.nocopk = m.products_id
  WHERE m.ecommerce_orders_id = o.nocopk
) lp ON true;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', COALESCE(p.airtable_id, p.nocopk::text), 'fields', json_build_object(
  'product_id', p.product_id,
  'name_mat', p.name_mat,
  'unit_size', COALESCE(p.net_weight_oz, p.net_weight_g, p.net_volume_ml),
  'item_category_mat', p.item_category_mat,
  'notes', p.notes,
  'storage_location', CASE WHEN p.storage_location_id IS NULL THEN ARRAY[]::text[] ELSE ARRAY[COALESCE(loc.airtable_id, loc.nocopk::text)] END,
  'label_company_prod', NULL
)) ORDER BY p.product_id), '[]'::json) AS records
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.nocopk = p.storage_location_id
WHERE p.product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(loc.name, '') NOT IN ('shipped', 'consumed', 'compost', 'expired')
LIMIT 100;

parameters.jsCode: const order=$('PGSQL - Get Assign Order').first().json||{}; const product=$('PGSQL - Get Assign Product').first().json||{}; const locResp=$('PGSQL - List Locations Assign').first().json||{}; const ship=((locResp.records||[]).find(r=>String(r.fields?.name||'')===String($env.AIRTABLE_SHIPPED_LOCATION_NAME||'Shipped'))||{}).id||''; if(!ship) throw new Error('Could not resolve Shipped location'); const of=order.fields||{}; const pf=product.fields||{}; const existing=Array.isArray(of.products)?of.products:[]; if(existing.includes(product.id)) throw new Error('Product already linked to this order'); const locs=Array.isArray(pf.storage_location)?pf.storage_location:[]; if(locs.includes(ship)) throw new Error('Product is already marked Shipped'); return [{json:{order_record_id:order.id, product_record_id:product.id, order_fields:{products:[...existing, product.id]}, product_fields:{storage_location:[ship]}, result:{ok:true, order_record_id:order.id, product_record_id:product.id, order_ref:String(of.order_code||of.ecwid_order_id||of.order_number||''), product_id:pf.product_id||'', message:'Product linked to order and marked shipped.'}}}];

{{ `WITH ord AS (
  SELECT nocopk FROM public.ecommerce_orders
  WHERE COALESCE(airtable_id, nocopk::text) = '${String($json.order_record_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  LIMIT 1
), prod AS (
  SELECT nocopk FROM public.products
  WHERE COALESCE(airtable_id, nocopk::text) = '${String(($json.order_fields?.products || []).slice(-1)[0] || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public._m2m_products_ecommerce_orders_ecommerce_orders(products_id, ecommerce_orders_id)
  SELECT prod.nocopk, ord.nocopk
  FROM prod, ord
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public._m2m_products_ecommerce_orders_ecommerce_orders existing
    WHERE existing.products_id = prod.nocopk
      AND existing.ecommerce_orders_id = ord.nocopk
  )
  RETURNING 1
)

{{ `WITH target_loc AS (
  SELECT nocopk FROM public.locations
  WHERE COALESCE(airtable_id, nocopk::text) = '${String(($json.product_fields?.storage_location || [])[0] || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  LIMIT 1
), upd AS (
  UPDATE public.products p
  SET storage_location_id = target_loc.nocopk,
      nc_updated_at = now()
  FROM target_loc
  WHERE COALESCE(p.airtable_id, p.nocopk::text) = '${String($json.product_record_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  RETURNING p.*
)
SELECT COALESCE(upd.airtable_id, upd.nocopk::text) AS id,
       json_build_object(
         'product_id', upd.product_id,
         'name_mat', upd.name_mat,
         'storage_location', CASE WHEN upd.storage_location_id IS NULL THEN ARRAY[]::text[] ELSE ARRAY[COALESCE(loc.airtable_id, loc.nocopk::text)] END
       ) AS fields
FROM upd
LEFT JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.nocopk = upd.storage_location_id;` }}
